description: Land Acquisition - Polawala, Mahaoya D/S Division, Ampara District and an amendment to the Gaz. Ex. No. 1975/88 of 15.07.2016, Badulla D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition notices under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land lots being acquired by the government for public purpose (road development), including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, encroachers, and exact measurements. The content falls squarely under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as defined in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) category, with no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories present.
